Matt — thanks, glad the demo landed well. High level reply and suggested MAP below; see attached high-level redline highlights.

Quick answers:
- License: the Order Form will grant Acme a customer license for the deployed instance (per Order Form term X). Redwood does not retain a license to run the customer-specific instance for customer workloads; we retain the right to run shared control-plane components per the MSA. We will flag the exact clause we recommend in the MSA annex.
- Evidence & audit: three practical options — (A) periodic read-only snapshot + remote attestation by Redwood; (B) escrow-lite: encrypted snapshot delivered to designated custodian with signing key; (C) live audit window (on-site or jump-host) for a time-boxed period. Each has tradeoffs (cost, timeline, security).
- Custodian options: independent custodian (third-party escrow vendors) or an accredited law firm. We can provide a short shortlist and estimated lead times.

Suggested mutual action plan (MAP):
1) Redwood to produce redline + MSA annex excerpt (by 05/16) — highlights included in attachment.
2) Redwood legal + Acme counsel to align on chosen evidence path (call week of 05/16).
3) If escrow-lite chosen, select custodian and execute custodian NDA + tech checklist (target 2 weeks).
4) Finalize Order Form/DocuSign (target 05/31).

Can we lock a 30-minute sync on Thu 05/16? I'm including Karthik (inference infra) and Laura (contracts) to help.

Attachments: redlines_highlights.pdf

Matt — adding some technical constraints and a proposed mechanical approach so legal has concrete options. Reply inline to Vanessa's MAP: 

Technical considerations (short):
- Snapshot content: we recommend snapshotting model artifacts + config + runtime container image layers needed for inference (no customer PII data). For customers who require proof of persistence, we can include a small sample dataset + hash manifest rather than full DB export.
- Operator access: two roles — Operator (Redwood-managed optional) and Customer Operator (Acme-managed). If Acme insists on operator-only handover, we can provide an operator credential handoff procedure + encrypted snapshot and KMS key rotation logs.
- Attestation: we can provide signed SHA256 manifests and a signed statement from Redwood infra on the snapshot generation time and checksums.

Practical evidence paths (cost/timeline):
A) Signed attestation + read-only snapshot manifest — low lift, 3-5 business days to produce; recommended for most deals.
B) Escrow-lite delivered to custodian (encrypted snapshot + key escrow) — medium lift, 2-4 weeks to onboard custodian and verify chain.
C) Full handover (operator access + on-site verification) — high lift, timeline depends on scheduling and mutual security arrangements.

Attached: custody_matrix.xlsx (matrix of options + estimated time/cost).

I'll be on the Thu 05/16 call.

-Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Gina / Matt — appreciate the clarity. Attached is a short proposed MSA annex excerpt (proposed_msa_excerpt.docx) and a few redline bullet points below which I will save for the call. I've kept the language pragmatic to avoid long negotiation cycles.

Key contract points (proposed):
- License Grant: "Subject to the Order Form, Redwood grants Customer a non-exclusive, perpetual-for-term license to use the deployed runtime instance and related deliverables for Customer internal business purposes during the Term. Redwood retains ownership of its general-purpose software and models; Customer license does not confer rights to redistribute or publish."
- Operator Access & Handover: "Redwood will provide a documented operator handover procedure including encrypted snapshot transfer and signed attestation. If Customer elects escrow-lite, the custodian will receive an encrypted package and a manifest signed by Redwood; Redwood will also provide KMS key rotation logs for the period specified in the Order Form."
- Audit & Evidence: "Customer may request a time-boxed audit window (up to 30 days per year) with prior notice. For routine verification, Redwood will provide signed manifests and diagnostic hashes within 5 business days. On-site or live access requires mutual agreement and reasonable travel/expense reimbursement."
- Custodian Liability: limit liability for custodian acts; Redwood will arrange custodian engagement but liability for the custodian's independent actions will be limited to the extent of the custodian agreement.

I'll present these points on the Thu call; happy to incorporate Acme's language during the sync.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
